title: Let's Learn English Lesson 34
subtitle: What Will I Do?
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 34: What Will I Do? (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Halloween is very popular in the United States.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！萬聖節在美國很流行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Children trick-or-treat. They ask people for candy. Children and adults wear costumes and go to parties!
dialogue.zh: 孩子們不給糖就搗蛋。他們向人要糖果。孩子和大人穿上服裝去參加派對！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, there is a Halloween party tonight. I need my friend, Genie. Genie!
dialogue.zh: 其實，今晚有一場萬聖節派對。我需要我的朋友吉妮。吉妮！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi!

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! What do you need?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Tonight, there is a Halloween party.
dialogue.zh: 今晚有一場萬聖節派對。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: I love Halloween! Are you going?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I might go. I might not go. I don't have a costume. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 我可能去。我也可能不去。我沒有服裝。你能幫我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Dress as a genie!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great idea! I can do a genie trick like read minds!
dialogue.zh: 好主意！我可以玩精靈把戲，比如讀心！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Anna, be careful. Things might go wrong.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，小心。事情可能會出錯。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What can go wrong?

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey, look! I'm a genie! This is going to be fun!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，看！我是精靈！這會很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Remember, Anna. Be careful!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Don't worry, Genie! I will!

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Excuse me, are you really a mind reader?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，你真的會讀心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I might be.

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Okay, tell me what I am thinking.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure! First, what do you do?
dialogue.zh: 當然！首先，你是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I study. I'm a junior in college.
dialogue.zh: 我在上學。我是大學三年級。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you study?

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I study journalism.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. Wait. You are thinking … you will graduate from college in about one year.
dialogue.zh: 好。等一下。你在想……你大約一年後會大學畢業。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Well, yeah. That's the plan. I told you, I'm a junior in college.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，對。那就是計劃。我告訴過你，我是大三。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right, um, wait. There's more. You are thinking … you might get a job writing the news.
dialogue.zh: 對，嗯，等一下。還有。你在想……你可能會得到一份寫新聞的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I MIGHT get a job writing the news? I MIGHT! That means I might not. And I'm studying really hard.
dialogue.zh: 我可能得到一份寫新聞的工作？可能！那意思是我也可能得不到。而且我學習很努力。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no, no, no. Uh, no, you will! You WILL get a job writing the news.
dialogue.zh: 不，不，不，不。呃，不，你會的！你一定會得到一份寫新聞的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I will?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You will.

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: I will. I think.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 'Bye. Happy to help!

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Can you really read minds?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I might.

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Well, today, I will ask my girlfriend to marry me. What am I thinking?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，今天，我會向女朋友求婚。我在想什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait. Wait, you are thinking ... you might have a wedding very soon!
dialogue.zh: 等一下。等一下，你在想……你可能很快就會辦婚禮！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Might? MIGHT? She won't say "no," will she?
dialogue.zh: 可能？可能？她不會說“不”，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no! She WILL say "yes"!

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: I will have a wedding, won't I?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You will. You will!

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Thanks. I think.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good luck!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is hard. Genie! Genie!

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Anna, what's wrong?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't want to be a genie for Halloween. I might not go to the party.
dialogue.zh: 萬聖節我不想當精靈了。我可能不去派對。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Of course you will go. I have another costume for you!
dialogue.zh: 你當然會去。我還有另一套服裝給你！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm a rock star! You read my mind!
dialogue.zh: 我是搖滾明星！你讀到我的心思了！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: No. You told me you like rock music.
dialogue.zh: 沒有。你告訴過我你喜歡搖滾樂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, right. Well, I love it!

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Have fun, Anna!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Genie!!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am ready for the Halloween party! But I am not going to read minds. I might play some rock music! Or I might not. Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 我準備好去萬聖節派對了！不過我不會讀心。我可能會彈點搖滾樂！也可能不彈。下次見……

quiz.prompt: What costume does Anna wear at the end?
